description: L1 meta gate: each child acceptance maps to a real test. FULL_IMPLEMENT must append entries for the parent being delivered. Empty entries is valid only when META_PARENT=pure-chore (PR body: <!-- hither-test-meta parent: pure-chore -->). Required parent ids fail L1 if zero matching entries.

entries.acceptance: Group tour pane and target geometry commit atomically; Add Place highlights the favorite star.
entries.testNamePattern: commits pane and target as one snapshot

entries.acceptance: Leader-only route reorder tour has six measured steps and a zero-gathering-point stop gate.
entries.testNamePattern: requires leader edit access

entries.acceptance: Push and Realtime fallback use nickname, destination title, and command message consistently.
entries.testNamePattern: uses sender nickname as title

entries.acceptance: Per-recipient pending refresh survives missed delivery and uses exact versioned ACKs with lifecycle guards.
entries.testNamePattern: keeps a per-recipient versioned ledger

entries.acceptance: A1 Starting a journey never leaves two Live Activities on the starter or a teammate device that already had a handle.
entries.testNamePattern: adopts an observed PTS handle

entries.acceptance: A2 Visible activity always includes destination title, avatars, progress, ETA (when known). No team-name-only teaser.
entries.testNamePattern: excludes starter / existing handles from PTS

entries.acceptance: A3 Progress matches gated walking remaining, not ungated 1 - current/initial.
entries.testNamePattern: uses gated walking remaining

entries.acceptance: A4 Destination change resets sticky max.
entries.testNamePattern: resets sticky max when the destination id changes

entries.acceptance: A5 Not entitled — no activity (not a reduced one).
entries.testNamePattern: does not start when not entitled

entries.acceptance: A6 Remote / background updates do not wipe title or avatars.
entries.testNamePattern: does not wipe title/avatars on background updateAll

entries.acceptance: B1 Expanding / collapsing a card does not replay Arrived enter animation.
entries.testNamePattern: animates only the first Start

entries.acceptance: B2 Arrived enter animation runs only on the first Start→Arrived split.
entries.testNamePattern: animates only the first Start

entries.acceptance: B3 All-arrived 完成 immediately closes the stop (card exit + history), even if auto-complete already ran.
entries.testNamePattern: always applies local closedAt

entries.acceptance: B4 Missing members: 取消 leaves the card; 完成 force-closes with card exit + history.
entries.testNamePattern: confirms with arrived x/x counts when members are missing

entries.acceptance: B5 Already-closed / idempotent RPC still applies local closedAt, #149 exit, and history refresh.
entries.testNamePattern: stamps closedAt locally

entries.acceptance: B6 complete_gathering_stop keeps closed_at and writes history rows.
entries.testNamePattern: projects history as own-or-leader

entries.acceptance: C1 Remaining first crosses ≤ total/5 → one local notify.
entries.testNamePattern: fires when remaining first crosses

entries.acceptance: C2 Already arrived, or arrivalRadiusM > total/5, or already fired → no notify.
entries.testNamePattern: skips when already arrived

entries.acceptance: C3 Approach never fans out to teammates.
entries.testNamePattern: is local-only copy

entries.acceptance: C4 Arrival notify is title=nickname, body=已抵達（destination）. No dest → none.
entries.testNamePattern: uses dest-required arrival

entries.acceptance: C5 Straggler notify is title=nickname, body=已脫隊（distance） or 已脫隊.
entries.testNamePattern: uses dest-required arrival

entries.acceptance: C6 APNs + Realtime for the same arrival event produce one banner.
entries.testNamePattern: keeps Realtime fallback copy

entries.acceptance: D1 Journey sharing uploads at least every 30s moving / 60s stationary.
entries.testNamePattern: journey uploads at least every 30s

entries.acceptance: D2 Non-journey sharing refreshes liveness at most every 2 minutes.
entries.testNamePattern: non-journey sharing refreshes liveness

entries.acceptance: D3 pausesUpdatesAutomatically is false while sharing.
entries.testNamePattern: uses fitness High accuracy

entries.acceptance: D4 No memberships, or sharing off — Expo watch, background task, outbox, and MapKit user location stop.
entries.testNamePattern: stops GPS when sharing is off

entries.acceptance: D5 Sharing toggle is in 成員, immediately right of 目前狀態.
entries.testNamePattern: keeps arrival beside navigation

entries.acceptance: D6 Toggling off drops the location indicator without killing the process.
entries.testNamePattern: stops GPS when sharing is off

entries.testNamePattern: keeps the RPC permanently deleting auth.users and allows registered self-delete

entries.acceptance: A2 Anonymous caller still permanently removes their auth.users row (existing logout contract).
